decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing a wide variety of aggressive Goblin creatures and powerful tribal synergies to overwhelm opponents in fast-paced 1 vs 1 games. With cards like Goblin Chieftain, Goblin King, and Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin, the deck can quickly build a formidable army of Goblins that can deal massive amounts of damage in a short amount of time. Additionally, cards like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push provide efficient removal options to deal with opponent threats, while cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon can disrupt opponent's mana bases. By applying constant pressure and maximizing tribal synergies, this deck aims to close out games quickly before opponents have a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. It aims to disrupt opponents' game plans while setting up its own win conditions through powerful creatures like Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite and Archon of Cruelty. The deck uses Aminatou, the Fateshifter's abilities to manipulate the top of the library and cheat out big threats with cards like Show and Tell and Reanimate. With a versatile mana base and a mix of card draw, disruption, and proactive threats, this deck aims to outvalue opponents and grind out wins in a competitive 1 vs 1 setting.

The deck focuses on playing a variety of multicolored cards in order to take advantage of Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw cards and put them into play. The key strategy is to control the board with a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and versatile creatures while ramping up mana for big plays. By utilizing Niv-Mizzet's ability to draw multiple cards at once, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and overwhelm them with powerful spells and creatures. The combination of control elements, card advantage, and a diverse range of threats makes this deck a versatile and potent force in the Duel Commander format.

This deck focuses on utilizing the partner commanders Sidar Kondo of Jamuraa and Tevesh Szat, Doom of Fools to create an aggressive strategy. The deck includes a mix of powerful and versatile spells such as Demonic Tutor, Abrupt Decay, and Swords to Plowshares, as well as efficient creatures like Dark Confidant, Voice of Resurgence, and Kitchen Finks. The deck aims to disrupt opponents with cards like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy, while also generating value through cards like Birthing Pod and Fauna Shaman. By combining strong removal, creature recursion, and card advantage, this deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with a fast and resilient aggro game plan in the Duel Commander format.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a low mana curve, utilizing cards like Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar to quickly pressure opponents and control the board. It includes a mix of creatures with strong abilities and cheap removal spells to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategies. The deck also has a graveyard recursion theme, allowing for repeated use of powerful cards like Ox of Agonas and Rotting Regisaur. It aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently, applying constant pressure and preventing them from stabilizing. The inclusion of cards like Demonic Tutor and Thoughtseize adds additional versatility and control options, ensuring that the deck can adapt to different matchups and maintain its aggressive momentum.

This deck focuses on utilizing Kytheon, Hero of Akros as the commander to lead an aggressive strategy designed to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes a variety of low-cost creatures with strong abilities that can quickly put pressure on the opponent, such as Auriok Champion, Brimaz, King of Oreskos, and Mirran Crusader. In addition, the deck includes powerful hate cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Containment Priest to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of equipment like Umezawa's Jitte and Sword of Fire and Ice further enhances the aggro plan by providing additional damage and utility. Overall, this deck aims to establish an early board presence and maintain pressure throughout the game to secure victory.

Queen Marchesa control deck focuses on disruption and removal spells to control the game and slow down opponents. It includes a variety of targeted removal spells like Fatal Push, Swords to Plowshares, and Vindicate, as well as board wipes like Wrath of God and Damnation. The deck also features hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Hymn to Tourach to disrupt opponents' strategies. Additionally, the deck includes planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to generate card advantage and apply pressure on opponents. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to control the game through removal, disruption, and powerful planeswalkers to outlast opponents and secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive tactics and maximizing the value of Winota, Joiner of Forces' ability to cheat powerful creatures onto the battlefield. It includes a mix of low-cost creatures with powerful effects, such as Goblin Guide and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, as well as disruptive cards like Thalia, Heretic Cathar and Drannith Magistrate to slow down opponents. The deck also includes cards like Anax, Hardened in the Forge and Pia and Kiran Nalaar for additional token generation and combat tricks. With a focus on fast, efficient creatures and disruption, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents and secure victory through combat damage.
